\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage[paperwidth=380pt,paperheight=390pt,textwidth=290pt,textheight=280pt,top=35pt,left=40pt]{geometry}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\pagestyle{empty}
\makeatletter
\newif\ifGeometryActive
\newif\ifGeometryBackground
\newcount\GeometryPaths
\newcount\GeometryPaints
\newcount\GeometryPictures
\newcount\GeometryBegin
\newcount\GeometryEnd
\newcount\GeometryFormatted
\newcount\GeometryHboxes
\newcount\GeometryVboxes
\newcount\GeometryMeasured
\newcount\GeometryCases
\newdimen\GeometryExpected
\newdimen\GeometryMinX
\newdimen\GeometryMaxX
\newdimen\GeometryMinY
\newdimen\GeometryMaxY
\newwrite\GeometryEvents
\newwrite\GeometryBounds
\immediate\openout\GeometryEvents=\jobname.events
\immediate\openout\GeometryBounds=\jobname.bounds
\def\GeometryError#1{\PackageError{geometry-contracts}{#1}{The frozen control and candidate must satisfy the same geometry contract.}}
\def\GeometryInt#1#2#3{\ifnum#1=#2\relax\else\GeometryError{#3}\fi}
\def\GeometryDim#1#2#3{\GeometryExpected=\dimexpr#2\relax
  \ifdim#1=\GeometryExpected\else\GeometryError{#3}\fi}
% Two retained option macros start with deliberately different values.
% Path-local options choose the actual left margin and top-left radius.
\def\GeometryLeft{13pt}
\def\GeometryTL{7pt}
\def\GeometryOnPath{%
  \ifGeometryActive
    \global\advance\GeometryPaths by1
    \ifnum\GeometryPaths=1
      \ifGeometryBackground\GeometryError{Content node moved to background}\fi
    \else
      \ifGeometryBackground
        \GeometryInt\GeometryPaths{2}{Background fill order changed}%
        \def\GeometryLeft{9pt}\def\GeometryTL{1pt}%
      \else
        \GeometryInt\GeometryPaths{3}{Foreground stroke order changed}%
        \def\GeometryLeft{11pt}\def\GeometryTL{3pt}%
      \fi
    \fi
  \fi}
\tikzset{
  geometry late/.code=\GeometryOnPath,
  geometry background/.code=\GeometryBackgroundtrue,
  every path/.append style={geometry late},
  every on background layer/.append style={geometry background},
  every picture/.append style={
    execute at begin picture={\ifGeometryActive\global\advance\GeometryBegin by1\fi},
    execute at end picture={\ifGeometryActive
      \global\advance\GeometryEnd by1
      \immediate\write\GeometryBounds{PICTURE \GeometryCase:
        \the\pgf@picminx,\the\pgf@picminy,\the\pgf@picmaxx,\the\pgf@picmaxy}%
    \fi}}}
\let\GeometryUsePath\pgfusepath
\def\pgfusepath#1{%
  \ifGeometryActive\ifnum\GeometryPaths>1
    \global\advance\GeometryPaints by1
    \GeometryMinX=\pgf@pathminx \GeometryMaxX=\pgf@pathmaxx
    \GeometryMinY=\pgf@pathminy \GeometryMaxY=\pgf@pathmaxy
    % These bounds follow directly from the named content rectangle and
    % four margins; no production contour/helper is used as the oracle.
    \pgfpointanchor{dte@content}{south west}%
    \GeometryDim\GeometryMinX{\pgf@x-\GeometryLeft}{Wrong left contour bound}%
    \GeometryDim\GeometryMinY{\pgf@y-8pt}{Wrong bottom contour bound}%
    \pgfpointanchor{dte@content}{north east}%
    \GeometryDim\GeometryMaxX{\pgf@x+7pt}{Wrong right contour bound}%
    \GeometryDim\GeometryMaxY{\pgf@y+6pt}{Wrong top contour bound}%
    \pgfgetpath\GeometrySoftPath
    \immediate\write\GeometryEvents{PATH \GeometryCase/\the\GeometryPaths:
      #1;left=\GeometryLeft;tl=\GeometryTL; \meaning\GeometrySoftPath}%
    \immediate\write\GeometryBounds{PATH \GeometryCase/\the\GeometryPaths:
      \the\GeometryMinX,\the\GeometryMinY,\the\GeometryMaxX,\the\GeometryMaxY}%
  \fi\fi
  \GeometryUsePath{#1}}
\let\GeometryWhole\dte@output@singleframe
\def\dte@output@singleframe{%
  \global\advance\GeometryPictures by1
  \GeometryActivetrue
  \GeometryWhole
  \GeometryActivefalse}
\let\GeometryBoxSingle\dte@box@single
\def\dte@box@single#1#2{%
  \global\advance\GeometryMeasured by1
  \GeometryBoxSingle#1#2}
\let\GeometryFormat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
  \global\advance\GeometryFormatted by1
  \GeometryFormat{#1}}
\def\GeometryStart#1#2{%
  \def\GeometryCase{#1}\def\GeometryExpectedMeasured{#2}%
  \global\GeometryMeasured=0 \global\GeometryPaths=0 \global\GeometryPaints=0
  \global\GeometryPictures=0 \global\GeometryBegin=0 \global\GeometryEnd=0
  \global\GeometryFormatted=0 \global\GeometryHboxes=0 \global\GeometryVboxes=0
  \everyhbox\expandafter{\the\everyhbox\global\advance\GeometryHboxes by1}%
  \everyvbox\expandafter{\the\everyvbox\global\advance\GeometryVboxes by1}}
\def\GeometryFinish{%
  \GeometryInt\GeometryMeasured{\GeometryExpectedMeasured}{Whole-picture measurement count changed}%
  \GeometryInt\GeometryPictures{1}{Whole output was rerendered or skipped}%
  \GeometryInt\GeometryPaths{3}{Expected content, fill, stroke paths}%
  \GeometryInt\GeometryPaints{2}{Expected one fill and one stroke action}%
  \GeometryInt\GeometryBegin{1}{Begin-picture hook count changed}%
  \GeometryInt\GeometryEnd{1}{End-picture hook count changed}%
  \GeometryInt\GeometryFormatted{3}{Semantic formatting count changed}%
  \GeometryDim{\GeometryLeft}{13pt}{Path-local left margin leaked}%
  \GeometryDim{\GeometryTL}{7pt}{Path-local radius leaked}%
  \typeout{GEOMETRY-MEASURED \GeometryCase: \the\GeometryMeasured}%
  \typeout{GEOMETRY-COUNTS \GeometryCase: \the\GeometryHboxes,\the\GeometryVboxes}%
  \typeout{GEOMETRY-OK \GeometryCase}%
  \global\advance\GeometryCases by1}
\AtEndDocument{\GeometryInt\GeometryCases{2}{Missing geometry scenario}%
  \typeout{GEOMETRY-ALL-CHECKS-PASSED}}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\begingroup
\GeometryStart{DIRECT}{0}
\begin{dirtreex}[pagebreak=false,
  box={corners={\GeometryTL,2pt,4pt,5pt},
       margin={6pt,7pt,8pt,\GeometryLeft},
       border width=1.5pt,border color=blue!70!black,background color=cyan!15}]
\dir{DIRECTROOT}{DCROOT}{
  \file{DIRECTONE}{DCONE}
  \file{DIRECTTWO}{DCTWO}
}
\end{dirtreex}
\GeometryFinish
\endgroup
\clearpage
\begingroup
\GeometryStart{FITTED}{1}
\begin{dirtreex}[pagebreak=true,
  box={corners={\GeometryTL,2pt,4pt,5pt},
       margin={6pt,7pt,8pt,\GeometryLeft},
       border width=1.5pt,border color=blue!70!black,background color=cyan!15}]
\dir{FITTEDROOT}{FCROOT}{
  \file{FITTEDONE}{FCONE}
  \file{FITTEDTWO}{FCTWO}
}
\end{dirtreex}
\GeometryFinish
\endgroup
\end{document}
